caption: The drawing depicts a decorative object resembling a pouch or small bag, centered on a plain beige background. The pouch has a polygonal shape with a flap at the top. The edge of the pouch and flap are outlined in red, with a thin blue outline just inside the red. The main surface of the pouch is black and is adorned with a symmetrical beadwork pattern of colorful flowers and leaves. The floral pattern consists of multiple flower shapes, each composed of circular or oval cluster-like bead arrangements. These shapes are rendered in various colors, including yellow, white, blue, purple, pink, red, and light blue, with green used for the leaves and stems. The flap of the pouch is decorated with three flowers and leaves, and a line of small, white beads runs along the edge separating the flap from the body of the pouch. The body features additional flowers and leaves in similar colors, filling the black background. The entire pouch composition is presented without any additional objects or background scenery, and a small handwritten text is visible near the lower right corner.
title: Purse
